verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail documents user-configurable features that run in the background on incoming mail. Users can write custom Auto Labels as AI prompts and turn on Auto Archive, and the assistant labels, drafts and sets follow-up reminders on its own. A trigger-based agent builder appears only on a general what's-new page and is not clearly tied to Mail, so it adds limited weight. Missing for 10: a general-purpose trigger/action automation builder clearly documented for Mail, autonomous actions beyond labeling, archiving and drafting (send actions need explicit approval), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: You can even make your own Auto Labels with short AI prompts like "job applications" or "requests to review work".
Superhuman AI can automatically archive marketing, cold pitches, and social network updates. Turn on Auto Archive, and eliminate inbox clutter for good.
Get an email assistant that automatically labels incoming emails, archives low-priority messages, drafts replies, and reminds you to follow up.
Emails are labeled the moment they arrive, so you can see what's important and what's not.
Use chat or our visual builder to create agents that run proactively based on triggers you set and the work you connect.
